name: audio
title: Whisper Audio Transcription
description: Offline audio transcription via a real whisper.cpp -- backs Mealie's Audio Provider (recipe-from-video import) and future scanner-call transcription.
notes: Pure CPU inference, no hardware passthrough needed. ~10x realtime on a 4c/8t CPU with no GPU (verified live) -- fine to run on modest hardware, not tested on a Pi specifically yet.
